name: pena
description: Local Markdown document review interface for Claude Code sessions — publish drafts, collect inline feedback in the browser, and pull it back into the session.
author: mshddev <mshddev@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @pena/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "pnpm --filter @pena/server dev" "pnpm --filter @pena/web dev"
